name: 工具箱
author: Yggdrasil
description: 示例插件：向 Agent 提供**新工具**（与内置 calc / now 同列，用 call_tool 调），而不是新操作。

tools.name: text_stats
tools.label: 文本统计
tools.description: Count characters / words / lines of a block of text and return the most frequent words. A **tool** (not an operation): it is listed under "Available tools" and you call it with call_tool. Use it when you would otherwise estimate counts by eye. No network.

params.name: top
params.description: how many frequent words to return (default 5)

top.description: how many frequent words to return, default 5

tools.name: slugify
tools.label: 生成短名
tools.description: Turn a title into a url/id-safe slug (lowercase, ASCII, hyphen separated). A **tool**: call it with call_tool. Useful before naming a workspace file or a component id.

tools.name: chunk
tools.label: 切分数组
tools.description: A **tool** that splits an array into chunks of N. Call it with call_tool. Handy when you fetched a long list and want to lay it out in columns or paginate it.
